verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS code-review and stacked-PR platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment: the core product runs as a hosted service authenticated through a GitHub App. A locally installed CLI is a client tool, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
